name: Dirty Laundry — Richard Pink and Roxanne Emery
description: Lived-experience and relationship-focused ADHD book by Richard Pink and Roxanne Emery, combining an ADHD perspective with a partner's perspective on everyday situations.
intended_use: Inspect a relationship and everyday-life perspective on ADHD, shame, misunderstandings and practical support.
audience_or_context: Adults with ADHD and partners, relatives or friends who want a lived-experience relationship perspective.
limitations: The authors' relationship is not representative of every ADHD relationship or every person with ADHD.
Practical advice in a commercial book is not a clinical treatment recommendation.
cost_or_access_notes: Commercial book in multiple formats; prices and availability vary by market.
conflicts_of_interest: The authors and publisher sell the book and related ADHD_Love media; ND Oracle keeps that commercial/lived-experience context visible.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
